gates.title: Packaged clipboard and watched-folder lifecycle
gates.limitation: Individual packaged lifecycle slices exist, but no repeatable automated packaged GUI journey covers every operation.

gates.title: Packaged global hotkey dispatch
gates.limitation: A real manual packaged journey exists, but collision and error behavior are not covered by a repository-owned GUI automation suite.

gates.title: Library provenance knowledge and lifecycle
gates.limitation: Source detail, citations, knowledge, and reversible visibility exist; the complete link and lifecycle journey is not proven end to end.

gates.title: Full-vault backup and restore
gates.limitation: Only component backups exist; no package restores the complete required state into a fresh application-support root.

gates.title: Grounded chat presentation
gates.limitation: Current retrieval, citations, identity, and bounded follow-up exist, but the full confidence and coverage presentation is not proven across the packaged journey.

gates.title: Frozen generated-claim evaluation
gates.limitation: Quality and abstention gates pass for the selected Gemma run, but warm end-to-end p95 exceeds 500 ms. A newer Qwen MoE failed quality and latency, the installed 423M candidate could not load, and the live evaluator CLI currently exits zero for a failed report.

gates.title: Ephemeral answers and explicit promotion
gates.limitation: Keep, discard, and task promotion exist; all named research and claim promotion paths are not yet available from generated chat.

gates.title: Explicit route grammar and visible failure
Zero outbound bytes for restricted fixtures
Live catalog and atomic model promotions
gates.limitation: Live catalog fetching and embedding promotion remain unavailable; only local profile and recorded-catalog foundations exist.

gates.title: Exact outbound and mutation approval
gates.limitation: Exact action-card binding and stale/reuse refusal exist, but every future outbound and mutating executor is not yet bound to the full contract.

gates.title: Persistent repository jobs and receipts
gates.limitation: Selected local repositories have durable jobs and removal lifecycle; approved remote clone and complete manifest coverage remain absent.

gates.title: Repository intake nonmutation
gates.limitation: Read-only committed intake is tested, but byte and Git-status comparison is not saved for every required success, cancellation, retry, failure, and restart path.

gates.title: Permitted repository content coverage
gates.limitation: Bounded documentation, code, test, and configuration capture exists; history, issue metadata, submodule, license, and secret-rule coverage is incomplete.

gates.title: Cited semantic observations and frozen evaluation
gates.limitation: Two named loopback models produced preserved failing v2 reports. Empty-ID abstention schemas are rejected before inference and deterministic concept matching rejects some semantically correct wording; no model passes a valid pre-registered live contract and no native live-repository semantic journey exists.

gates.title: Evidence-complete idea cards
gates.limitation: The semantic path enforces cited counterevidence, confidence, snapshot license, rejected alternatives, and a smallest experiment; legacy/manual cards still permit empty rejected alternatives and expose license provenance without a reviewed compatibility status.

gates.title: Explicit idea promotion
gates.limitation: Local task, research-plan, and Codex-plan proposals exist; retained research-packet promotion and live bounded coordination do not.

gates.title: Code adaptation provenance
gates.limitation: No donor code was copied in the reviewed Agno adaptation; a final provenance audit must cover any later code adaptation.

gates.title: Policy-gated research acquisition
gates.limitation: No approved web or document acquisition transport, durable job, or complete cost and source-quality receipt exists.

gates.title: Typed and separately cited research results
gates.limitation: Citation-verified facts, fact-bound inferences, and contradiction records are distinct; ResearchPacket has no typed unanswered-question or recommendation collections.

gates.title: Native validated-packet review
gates.limitation: A component Keep store exists, but no native acquired-packet review and discard surface is implemented.

gates.title: External output remains untrusted data
gates.limitation: Policy and prompt-injection fixtures exist, but there is no live acquisition path on which to prove the complete invariant.

gates.title: Pinned live CAM runtime verification
gates.limitation: A real installed runtime, config, corpus, capability surface, and disposable-copy health path are pinned, but the app does not yet perform the probe; nominal CAM status commands mutate startup state and cannot safely target the personal corpus.

gates.title: Bounded resumable coordination loop
gates.limitation: Event-sourced planning, evidence, budget, cancellation, and replay exist; live execution and complete terminal integration do not.

gates.title: Closed typed CAM executor
gates.limitation: No live closed tool registry with timeouts, retries, idempotency, postconditions, and failure receipts exists.

gates.title: Exact-approved CAM mining plan
gates.limitation: A digest-bound proposal and approval contract exists, but it is not bound to a live executor and disposable runtime.

gates.title: Disposable CAM integration proof
gates.limitation: No isolated disposable CAM corpus and configuration integration has run.

gates.title: Failure cannot become verified success
gates.limitation: Reducer and unavailable-executor tests fail closed, but the invariant is not yet proven against a live closed executor.

gates.title: Read-only Mac assessment evidence
gates.limitation: Space and application/startup counts exist; item-level duplicate and organization evidence with uncertainty is missing.

gates.title: Closed reversible Mac action set
gates.limitation: No available action executor, postcondition receipt, cancellation, or tested undo exists.

gates.title: Versioned trusted module manifests
gates.limitation: Versioned manifests declare core metadata, but signing or local-trust policy, uninstall behavior, and packaged resources are incomplete.

gates.title: Discovery and enablement grant no permission
Explicit permission receipts and isolated health
gates.limitation: Health isolation and registry-side grant enforcement are tested; permission-change receipts, expected-state revisions, real manifest health execution, and native review remain incomplete.

gates.title: Packaged home-grown module lifecycle
gates.limitation: No module is packaged, installed, granted, exercised, disabled, removed, and restart-verified end to end.

gates.title: Complete compact and expandable workspace
gates.limitation: The native shell is real, but Modules and Approvals workspaces are absent and CAM remains status-only.

gates.title: Keyboard VoiceOver focus motion and state proof
gates.limitation: Focused and manual slices exist; complete VoiceOver speech, tab order, visual, large-data, and every-state journeys are missing.

gates.title: Fresh-user and restart/recovery journeys
gates.limitation: Individual isolated slices exist, but no unified fresh-user journey or whole-product restart and full-vault recovery journey passes.

gates.title: Complete aggregate verifier
gates.limitation: Unit, release, portability, package identity, and credential scan run; packaged GUI, full recovery, and broader accessibility proof are not automated.

gates.title: Reproducible unsigned package and gated distribution
Complete final release report
gates.limitation: The current report is honest and requirement-oriented, but it is not the final all-gates-passing report with the complete environment, artifact, performance, rollback, and non-claim record.
